summary.title: ISEC6000 Assessment 3 - STRIDE Threat Model
summary.description: Threat model for the Express-ES6-Sample application deployed via AWS CodePipeline to Elastic Beanstalk (ISEC6000 Assessment 3, Task 5). Covers three components: the Web Application (Express.js/Node.js app), the Database (PostgreSQL instances used by NextCloud and Clair in this assessment), and the User Interface (browser client accessing the deployed app).
